title: Forward Deployed Engineering: The Complete Course
tagline: Discovery, messy data, integrations, LLM systems built with Claude, and production support — the full FDE playbook, taught through hands-on Python exercises you complete right in your browser.

modules.title: The FDE Role & Mindset
modules.summary: What forward deployed engineers actually do, how the role differs from SWE, solutions engineering and consulting, and the operating loop you'll run on every engagement.

Run the discover → build → deploy → measure → feed back loop
